name: Gremlin
desc: A wiry snaggle-fanged gremlin rendered as a dark engraving, huge splaying ears and acid-yellow eyes, twitching, skittering, and pouncing with menace on the beat.

scale.doc: hero size vs design (~0.5*min(w,h) tall at 1)

pose.doc: auto follows act; idle=twitch, skitter=manic beat dance, snarl=pounce scare, lurk=low creep

style.doc: aesthetic: etching=dark cross-hatched engraving, toxic=near-black w/ acid neon rim+eye glow, wireframe=schematic construction lines (abstracted), thermal=false-color heatmap no-outline, classic=flat cartoon

act.doc: multi-minute pose program indexed by section
